messages:
mia: Kicking off a short livestream + benchmark demo next Wed 9am PT. Goal: drive dev activation via 400 trials. Experiment: give 600 starter credits + "starter-prompts-v2" pack, then A/B test credit size 600 vs 1200 and subject line variants.
sam: Nice. Suggest focusing primary KPI on 'first meaningful response (FMR) within 48h' instead of raw credits used.
mia: Agreed. FMR primary, credit consumption secondary.
oliver: Routing plan: tag signup with utm=livestream, add intent_score field on form (1-10). route intent>=8 to microcohort (max 50), sales domains flagged.
jean: I'll draft 3 short social posts and a landing hero. lucy to build prompt pack (codegen, summarization, assistant, rerank, prompt-playbook).
lucy: Prompt pack draft ready by Thu. also propose a 1-click "apply starter pack" button in the onboarding flow.
sam: Staging webhook snippet for ops test:
{
  "source": "livestream",
  "credits": 600,
  "prompt_pack": "starter-prompts-v2",
  "route": {"microcohort": true, "min_intent": 8}
}
deploy-bot: created staging webhook https://staging.redwood.ai/webhooks/live-demo-3124012
mia: Also plan two office hours sessions limited to 30 devs each. Jean/lucy please drop assets in #marketing-review by Thu EOD. sam/oliver run staging tests Fri AM and post event metrics to experiment dashboard.
jean: Will include a 1-slide benchmark: median vs p95 latency, $/token delta, sample prompt output quality.
mia: Add rollback/fallback note to show if a model regresses. enterprise email domains should be marked sales_lead and not auto-credited.
oliver: I'll ensure signup form captures team size and use-case to prioritize microcohort selection.
sam: I'll create the experiment tag experiment=livestream-starter-v2 and build a basic GA funnel.
mia: Thanks—short validation next: test prompt pack with 5 internal devs before going live. keep updates in #marketing and paste final links here before launch. :rocket:
